sent_bad: Consent must be freely given: "When assessing whether consent is freely given, utmost account shall be taken of whether, inter alia, the performance of a contract, including the provision of a service, is conditional on consent to the processing of personal data that is not necessary for the performance of that contract" (doc.txt).
"the processing of the personal data of a child shall be lawful where the child is at least 16 years old" (doc.txt).

"Where the child is below the age of 16 years, such processing shall be lawful only if and to the extent that consent is given or authorised by the holder of parental responsibility over the child," with Member States able to set a lower age "provided that such lower age is not below 13 years" (doc.txt).
The document does not state any further circumstances (e.g., timing or manner) under which a person may give consent beyond these provisions.
